notes: Physical grenades were rebalanced against FEHA firearm lethality: standard frags now deal 12d6, incendiaries 10d6, cutting 10d6, EMP 6d6-7d6, biohazard 8d6, and Ozob's Nose 15d6.

Added FEHA_GRENADE_RUNTIME.js with player-safe silent GM authority, measured-template placement, Homing and Sticky targeting behavior, one-roll AoE damage, saving throws, automatic short-duration statuses, automatic burn/bleed ticks, EMP cyberware disable/restore, Prone and blast knockback.

Persistent Smoke and Recon Sticky zones are real MeasuredTemplate documents, automatically follow attached tokens where appropriate, apply/remove zone markers, and delete themselves when their duration expires. Recon Regular performs an immediate 30-ft scan and self-cleans its template.
Native dnd5e grenade use is intercepted so using a grenade enters FEHA placement/targeting instead of the old empty consumable flow. Point throws show a live radius ghost before confirmation.
Cookoff now routes carried FEHA grenades directly through the canonical grenade runtime so hacked explosives detonate on the victim using their normal grenade damage, area, and effects.
